conventions.regret: latency above the per-call oracle (fastest timed chunk of each call)
conventions.ms_per_forward_pass: regret per scan call x scan layers of the checkpoint
conventions.ms_per_request: ms_per_forward_pass / batch (kernel level); total regret / requests (replay)
conventions.replay_gpu_time: step model of the replay: 2 ms per step + 10 us per prefill token; decode 20 us per generated token after the first (ideal batching; decode lower bound)

256.denominator_note: measured; prefill measured with the reference scan

1024.denominator_note: routed 976-token prompt for captured L=1024; prefill measured with the reference scan

4096.denominator_note: measured; prefill measured with the reference scan

5_best_single_chunk.note: Table IV's best single chunk minimizes the summed per-call normalized latency on the training folds (chunk 256 in every fold) and is reported as the mean of per-call relative regrets; VII-H's single profiled chunk minimizes the mean absolute latency (chunk 512) and is reported as total latency above the oracle divided by that chunk's total latency. Different chunk and different estimator.

6_decision_overhead_o.definition: mean over the 2360 captured Mamba-1 calls (RTX PRO 6000) of the isolated full-histogram decision time (histogram K=256 + host sync + rule) at the nearest of the twelve measured tensor sizes
6_decision_overhead_o.table_V_context: RTX 3090, reference CUDA scan inside the 370M model, 4096 tokens, batch 1, all 48 layers
6_decision_overhead_o.nearest_size_note: the nearest-size lookup matches tensor sizes only (L x batch x width), so a batch-1 call of L = 2048 takes the first measured row of equal size (L = 128, batch 16)
